record.question: Typical color Doppler angle is:
record.explanation: Answer B: 30-60 degree. Doppler angle correction is commonly kept in the approximate 30°–60° range; exact optimal angle depends on vessel/measurement. Source/context note: Optimal Doppler angle depends on measurement; angle correction is typically kept at or below 60°. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
